name: Fujishiro Meguru
source:
"Come back. Before the song makes you a sinner."

He is the director of the music control bureau "Rindou," meaning he has absolute power. In order not to repeat the tragedies of the past, he keeps a strict and close eye on the music industry. His work life is his main focus, and his ability to make a living is devastating.

In addition, he has a somewhat unhappy disposition, is always being pushed around by the people around him, sighs a lot, and cannot remove the wrinkles from his brow.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/fujishiro_meguru.html]official website[/url]]
